reports.summary:
H-design finished its work list. All targeted tests pass (63 in MXRUISnapshotTests plus the Core store tests). The three new or tightened test files fail with their fix reverted.

- **Light bars now match Figma's layer stack exactly.** Figma's Player - Light is a black fill, then the video image (it reads #2D2B29 under the bars), then BG/A3 Transparent with a background blur. The product now uses that same video colour for the base under the pinned bars (new token `videoUnderBars`, used by `MXRBackdropBase`). The bars draw the tint over it with no NSVisualEffectView. They read exactly #ABABAA offscreen (they read #A7A7A7 before), whatever is behind them. D053 no longer excuses a difference.
- **S63 dropdowns drop below the field.** Settings and side-panel lists open one anchor gap below a field that stays visible, and the field keeps its down chevron, as in video 17m31.0. The preset list and the dialog header pop-ups still open over their field (video 07m58.9 and 06m08.5).
- **S70 onboarding preview uses the Mac window chrome:** traffic lights, then the cone, and only the fullscreen button on the right. In Light, the swatches use the Light accents and the preview bars are the real Light window's bars.
- **S71 onboarding shortcuts match the installed app.** Modifiers use the ⇧ glyph. With VLC's Mac engine bindings (C-bridge's mock fix), the old layout drew empty keycaps and dropped the '/'. A row with two bindings now writes each binding as one keycap ("⌥⌘←"), and nothing gets squeezed.
- **S66 volume tile:** the dashed box is now 130×36, as in Figma.
- **Gallery deviations:** S72.Window/light and the S70/S71 entries now record their documented deviations.
- **DECISIONS.md:** D015, D022, D026, D032, D034, D049 and D053 are amended (listed under ownerDecisions).
fixed: (d) Light bars #A7A7A7 vs Figma #ABABAA. Figma's stack under the bars is a black fill, then the video image (#2D2B29 at the bar edges), then #D5D5D5 @ 0.75 with a 50 pt background blur. The product now uses that video colour as the base under the pinned bars (raw colour 2425:13624 → Theme.Color.videoUnderBars, MXRBackdropBase). In the Light window the bars draw the tint over that base with no material (MXRBackdropSurface(overCanvasBase:), set through the mxrBarsBesidePicture environment value from MXRAppView). Offscreen all bar samples are now (171,171,170); the bar flat-colour FAIL is gone (flat 0.099 %, was 6.14 %). The same path, with no material, runs in the real window. The remaining S72 FAIL is E-library's thumbnail at 70,752. Evidence: ../build/evidence/final5/polish/H-design/after/S72_Window_light/, after/bars_render_vs_figma.png, before/S72_Window_light/

(d) S63 dropdown placement: standard lists drop below the field (MXRDropdownListPlacement, .below with the anchor gap, above when there is no room). The preset list and DialogMenu (overField: true) stay over the field. The standard field keeps its down chevron while open (17m31.0). Test: DropdownPlacementTests. Evidence: before/figma_dropdowns.png; key frames 17m31.0 and 06m08.5

(d) S70 mini player preview: Windows controls replaced by Mac chrome (new Theme.MacWindowControls token group measured from the shipping-window traffic lights: 12 pt, 8 pt apart, at 13 pt; cone after them with the left-group gap; fullscreen only). The S70 entries carry a D022 deviation for the preview top bar, so the check shows only the frame-edge alpha strip. Evidence: after/S70_render_over_figma.png, after/S70_Onboarding_{orange,teal,blue}/

S70 light variant: swatches are each accent's Accent/Main in the theme shown, so the selected one is #E8851A like Next. In Light the preview bars are the Light window's own bars (BG/A3 Transparent over the canvas base, #ABABAA). Evidence: after/S72_Onboarding_light.png

(d) S71: checked against the engine's __APPLE__ defaults (the C-bridge mock now reports them). With those bindings the old keycaps rendered empty and the '/' disappeared. Fixed: ⇧ glyph instead of 'SHIFT'; one keycap per binding when a row has two bindings; keycaps and rows are fixedSize, so nothing truncates. Gallery notes updated, with a D026 deviation on the keycap columns. Tests: OnboardingShortcutKeycapTests. Evidence: before/S71_Onboarding_shortcuts/side-by-side.png, after/S71_Onboarding_shortcuts/render.png

S66 item 1: volume group dashed box 4 pt too tight. Now 130×36 around the speaker and cone, per Figma 2115:7291 (metrics.json customization.outline.volumeHorizontal 5 / volumeVertical 4; LayoutDrag outset for .volume). Evidence: after/S66_volume_box_render_over_figma.png

verdict.summary:
H-design passes round 1. Every work-list item is either fixed or covered by a decision with evidence. No blocker or major remains that code, tests or renders can establish.

Build and tests:
- `swift build` is clean.
- The targeted suites pass: 63 MXRUISnapshot tests plus Core, among them LightBarBackdrop, DropdownPlacement, OnboardingShortcutKeycap, FigmaDeviation, Customization*, Onboarding*, WindowShippingParity, WindowComposition, LayoutStore and MockShortcutDefaults.
- The fixer's revert log shows that all three new or tightened tests fail with their fix reverted.
- The engine diff (`git diff upstream-base-2026-10-14 -- src lib include modules/gui/macosx`) is empty.

Item by item:
- **(d) Light bars: fixed.** The S72.Window/light shipping-window render reads (171,171,170) at every bar sample, the same as Figma, and the video under them is (45,43,41) in both. The bar flat-colour FAIL is gone (flat 0.063 %). The only remaining FAIL is E-library's thumbnail at 70,752.
  - The layer stack is correct: Figma's #2D2B29 video under BG/A3 @ 0.75 gives exactly #ABABAA. The product draws the same tint over a raw-colour token with no NSVisualEffectView, only while the bars are pinned beside the Light picture (`.underBars`, no full library).
  - D053's bullet no longer excuses a difference.
- **S63 dropdown: fixed.** `MXRDropdownListPlacement` drops standard lists one anchorGap below the field, and above it when there is no room. Only the preset list and DialogMenu open over the field. This matches video 17m31.0 (the gap there is about 7 pt). Figma's "open" variant is only a component-set layout, so the video is the right source.
- **S70: fixed.** I looked at the render over Figma. The preview now shows traffic lights, then the cone, and only fullscreen on the right. In Light, the selected swatch is #E8851A, the same as Next, and the preview bars are #ABABAA.
- **S71: fixed.** The render shows Mac engine defaults with the ⇧ glyph, no empty keycaps and the '/' separators.
- **S66 volume box: fixed.** The crop of render over Figma lines up at 130×36.
- **Disabled-opacity token:** present, `controlBar.iconButton.disabledOpacity` 0.3. PlayerControls has no literal 0.4 left.
- **D015 PiP leftover:** fixed.
- **S72 gallery deviations (D048 and D049):** added.
- **S50 Light Settings:** recorded as a D032 amendment. Figma has no Light Settings frame, and the 17m44.0 frame is mid-transition, so the record is defensible; the owner may still choose the video's look.
- **Regressions:** none. S01.Window/shipping is still PASS, C.Dropdown/default-open and S67.Customization/two-row-edit are still REVIEW. S66.App/customization (bar Δ3) and S66.Customization/default (no real blur offscreen) were already listed as FAILs in integration.json. S69, S70 and S71 FAIL only on the documented frame-edge alpha strip at 0,752.

Ownership: the edits outside H-design's files are declared and minimal. The rowTop refactor in MXRPopupStyle and MXRPopupPresenter is not in H-design's report and looks like another area's work.

Evidence: ../build/evidence/final5/polish/H-design-verify-r1/ (check/S72_light/report samples, check/S70_Onboarding_orange/topbar_render_over_figma.png, check/S71_Onboarding_shortcuts/keycaps.png, check/S66A/vol.png, onb-light.png, general-light.png).

issues.description: S71 mixes two keycap styles on one screen. Rows with one binding split the modifiers into separate keycaps ('⌘' 'F', '⌥' '⌘' 'S'). Paired rows combine each binding into one keycap ('⌘↑', '⌥⌘←'). The D026 amendment documents this and the result is legible, but it looks inconsistent next to Figma's split style. The owner should confirm.

issues.where: Settings accent swatches (F-settings) vs onboarding swatches (H-design, D049 amendment)
issues.description: In Light, the onboarding swatches now use Light/Accent/Main (#E8851A). The Settings › General accent swatch row still draws the dark swatch hex #D37918 (sampled at 722,178 in S48.Settings/general-light). The same picker therefore looks different in two places. Either align Settings or extend the D049 bullet.

The pale BG/Accent Bright selected segment and ON cell, and the BG/A4 Browse, differ from video 17m44.0 (solid accent, white text, near-black Browse). Keeping them is defensible, since Figma has no Light Settings frame and the video frame is mid-transition. It is still an agent decision waiting for the owner, not an unjustified excuse.

The traffic-light colours and geometry are hand-written constants in a Theme file, not generated from tokens JSON. This is acceptable as a Theme token group, but it is not in colors.json or metrics.json and has no Figma node. It stands in for a picture of AppKit chrome.
